eval: (() => { const ks = []; for (let i = 0; i < localStorage.length; i++) { const k = localStorage.key(i); if (k && k.startsWith('dao-')) ks.push(k); } ks.forEach(k => localStorage.removeItem(k)); location.reload(); return 'cleared:' + ks.join(','); })()

(() => JSON.stringify({ slots: document.querySelectorAll('.slot').length, pool: document.querySelectorAll('.pool-card').length, btnTalents: !!document.getElementById('btn-talents'), btnBag: !!document.getElementById('btn-bag'), dao: typeof window.__dao, outcome: document.getElementById('outcome')?.textContent }))()

(() => { window.__dao.setStage(0); const types = root => [...document.querySelectorAll(root + ' .slot')].map(s => (s.className.match(/st-(\w+)/) || [])[1]).join(','); return JSON.stringify({ enemies: window.__dao.state.enemyQueue.length, playerTypes: types('#player-slots'), enemyTypes: types('#enemy-slots') }); })()

(() => { const slot = document.querySelector('#player-slots .slot.usable:not(.occupied)'); if (!slot) return 'no empty usable slot'; const r = slot.getBoundingClientRect(); slot.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('pointermove', { bubbles: true, clientX: r.left + r.width / 2, clientY: r.top + r.height / 2 })); return 'hover:' + slot.className; })()

(() => { const t = document.getElementById('card-tip'); if (!t) return 'no #card-tip'; const r = t.getBoundingClientRect(); return JSON.stringify({ w: Math.round(r.width), h: Math.round(r.height), cls: t.className, text: t.textContent.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 120) }); })()
(() => { window.__dao.setStage(10); return JSON.stringify({ stage: 10, enemies: window.__dao.state.enemyQueue.length }); })()

(() => { document.getElementById('btn-talents').click(); const click = id => document.querySelector('.tnode[data-id="' + id + '"]')?.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true })); click('f1'); click('f2'); return JSON.stringify({ enemiesAfterTalent: window.__dao.state.enemyQueue.length, slots: window.__dao.slots() }); })()

(() => { const svg = document.getElementById('talent-svg'); const before = svg.getAttribute('viewBox'); const r = svg.getBoundingClientRect(); const cx = r.left + r.width * 0.3, cy = r.top + r.height * 0.3; for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) svg.dispatchEvent(new WheelEvent('wheel', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, clientX: cx, clientY: cy, deltaY: -120 })); return JSON.stringify({ before, after: svg.getAttribute('viewBox') }); })()

(() => { document.getElementById('talent-close').click(); const types = [...document.querySelectorAll('#player-slots .slot')].map(s => (s.className.match(/st-(\w+)/) || [])[1]).join(','); return JSON.stringify({ playerTypes: types, enemiesFinal: window.__dao.state.enemyQueue.length }); })()
